args.title: Halvorsen Supply newsletter — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Halvorsen Supply's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to their blog article and a companion piece (free registration via email).
- Article (blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse): Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion, registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
